sources.authority: State tax authorities and Streamlined Sales Tax
sources.review: State/local boundaries and software taxability required. California electronic-only downloaded software is generally exempt; New York prewritten software by download or remote access is taxable. No national fallback; no inference that subscription cadence means SaaS. SST is not all-state coverage; future-effective quarterly files must not activate early.
National standard-rate evidence and imported digital-product regime located. Product supply, customer status, effective dates, territory and registration review still required.
GST/HST is province-dependent; provincial PST and Quebec QST need separate authority review. Do not use a single Canada rate or assume federal registration covers provincial taxes.
Remote-service guidance includes apps/software. Customer location evidence and registration are separate gates; legal applicability to these offers not approved.
Authority explicitly lists software access/downloads and updates at 25%. Norway VAT-area boundaries and registration still need review; not a rule for Svalbard/Jan Mayen.
Current standard rate and overseas-vendor remote-service guidance located. Customer/registration and product applicability remain unapproved.

sources.authority: United Arab Emirates Federal Tax Authority
sources.review: Standard rate and electronic-service place-of-use guidance located. Actual product classification, customer location and registration still require review.
B2C electronic-service and 2025 platform-taxation guidance located. Confirm direct-vendor vs designated-platform treatment, applicable rate and effective dates before candidate import.
Digital-service VAT regulations located. B2C collection vs B2B withholding, effective date, registration and product scope require review.

2026 IBS/CBS transition and compliance-dependent collection treatment make a single old Brazil percentage unsafe. Imported software, existing taxes and supply-specific obligations require specialist/source review.

sources.authority: Hong Kong Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau
sources.review: Authority states no VAT or sales tax. This is a no-tax-regime candidate, not missing data and not a fabricated tax registration. An explicit reviewed non-collection policy is needed; current local engine cannot express that distinction.
Foreign electronic-service guidance and current VAT page located. Confirm current rate against withdrawn 2025 rate-change proposals, B2B exceptions and registration before importing.
Foreign electronic-service regime located. Confirm currently effective reduced rate and expiry/extension dates, customer type and registration; do not hardcode an old reduced rate indefinitely.
Digital-service 8% transition guidance located. Confirm effective-date, exemption and product scope under subsequent changes before candidate activation.
Foreign-supplier registration procedure located, not sufficient rate or software-taxability evidence. Software-specific treatment and current law remain unresolved.
2026 VAT implementing-law announcement located. Cross-border software/intangibles, withholding, rates and detailed implementing rules need review; announcement alone is not rate evidence.
